Messages.Author: Sanabas
Messages.Body:
What happens if the weapon brought into play by the bauble is burnt? What I
think happens is nothing, until the vamp with the bauble burns the bauble,
and burns the already burnt weapon. The other possibilities I can think of
are that the bauble burns when the weapon does, or the bauble stays and
can't be burnt, since the vamp can't burn the weapon and the bauble as per
card text, because the weapon has already burnt.

Matt
